subject: Steering committee: Redwood + Fintegrate — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>

Subject: Steering committee: Redwood + Fintegrate — next steps

Hi Tom — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of call:
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for real-time LLM inference for Fintegrate’s customer support summarization use case.
- Key constraints: PII handling, SOC 2 evidence, procurement/PO timeline, and success = 30% reduction in manual summarization time without regression in quality.
- Architecture note: want to verify VPC/private deployment for production (sensitive data).

Immediate asks / next steps: 
1) Steering committee meeting with exec sponsor (economic buyer), security, and procurement to review risk and procurement path.
2) Share Fintegrate’s procurement and security questionnaires in advance, and confirm who will lead each item (security, legal, procurement).
3) Provide short list of decision criteria (top 3) and timelines for a purchasing decision.

Proposed meeting slots (30-45m):
- Tue Mar 3, 11:00-11:45 PT / 14:00-14:45 ET
- Mon Mar 9, 11:00-11:45 ET (flexible)

I've attached a short post-call deck summarizing capability/next steps and a proposed draft agenda. Rishi (cc) will own the technical deep dive and can present our architecture and SOC 2 summary. 

Attachments: 20260225-redwood-postcall-deck.pdf

If you can confirm the exec sponsor and preferred slot I'll lock the invite and send a short agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Steering committee: Redwood + Fintegrate — next steps

Marissa — I'm good to present on Mar 9. Adding a few technical notes I think will be helpful for the steering committee packet and to pre-empt likely security/procurement questions:

Technical notes for packet (to include in SOC2 packet / appendix):
- Deployment modes: Hosted API (quick eval), Dedicated cluster (reserved GPUs), Private VPC (recommended for production with PII).
- Data handling: optional request-level redaction + customer-managed KMS for key separation.
- Performance: 95th pct latency targets by model family; continuous batching with predictable SLOs.
- Pilot ask: 30-60 day pilot with production-ish traffic (scope: customer support summarization), sample success metrics + PO to cover reserved capacity if needed.

Attachments: redwood-arch-diagram.png

I also recommend we include a very short live demo (10 min) showing request flow and privacy controls - helps execs visualize the solution. I'll prep a 5-slide appendix for any deep-dive follow-ups.

Connor — can you confirm the calendar invite and include the DocuSign NDA link (if Fintegrate wants)?

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
